Overview

Groningen is a city in Groningen with a population of 243,768. A vibrant, youthful student city in the north with a strong cultural scene, cycling culture, and the most affordable living costs among major Dutch cities. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
